_comment: Vercel serves the exported pages and forwards /api to the API service.
The rewrite happens in Vercel's routing layer, before the static files are
served, so it works with output: 'export' where Next's own rewrites do not.
The browser only ever sees this app's own origin. That means the session
cookie is not cross-site, so samesite=lax keeps working, and there is no
CORS to configure on the API. Nothing needs setting in the Vercel dashboard
Change the destination below to the API service's URL. It cannot be an
environment variable: vercel.json does not interpolate them.
